d: The MEP Storekeeper is responsible for managing, receiving, storing, issuing, and maintaining records of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) materials, tools, equipment, and consumables. The role ensures proper inventory control and timely availability of materials to support project operations.
q: Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a Storekeeper, preferably in MEP, Electrical, or Construction projects
Knowledge of MEP materials, tools, and equipment
Familiarity with inventory management systems and Microsoft Office applications
Ability to work independently and maintain accurate inventory records
Basic English communication skills; Arabic is an advantage
r: Receive, inspect, and verify incoming MEP materials against purchase orders and delivery notes
Store materials in designated locations and maintain proper stock organization
Issue materials, tools, and equipment to site personnel based on approved requisitions
Maintain accurate stock records and update inventory transactions in the system
Monitor stock levels and inform management of reorder requirements
Conduct periodic physical inventory counts and reconcile discrepancies
Prepare Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), Material Issue Vouchers (MIV), and stock reports
Ensure proper handling and storage of cables, conduits, fittings, switchgear, lighting fixtures, plumbing materials, and MEP consumables
Coordinate with Procurement, Project Engineers, and Site Supervisors regarding material requirements
Maintain housekeeping and safety standards within the store area
Ensure all tools and equipment are properly logged and tracked
Assist in material audits and inventory verification activities
